objective: Deliver the simulation foundation, DesignPackage traceability, reviewed Agent change workflow, and private hardware/protocol handoff as one candidate against main.
in_scope: Jazzy simulation safety gate and fake base with no physical driver
Versioned design-only compatibility and v2 implementation readiness checks
A scoped ChangeContract and deterministic local/CI evidence manifests
Repository Skills and optional read-only review handoff
Direct local requirement-to-code and review routing with plan and final contract gates
Private hardware selection and received-protocol workflow rules, with safe public validation
Bounded readiness wait for the installed simulation restart test
Independent Agent feedback repairs for stale safety inputs and trustworthy ChangeContract validation
out_of_scope: Physical devices, production parameters, and hardware output
Unbounded source repair, automatic push, merge, or release
Live GitHub ruleset changes before candidate CI is verified
Concrete procurement, unverified device drivers, and physical trials
invariants: SafetyGate stays fail-closed at startup and after restart.
Physical output remains disabled and all motion tests use only fake ROS nodes.
No AI-authored file or JSON field is treated as human approval.
stop_conditions: A diff touches a path outside allowed_paths or changes a safety invariant.
An implemented requirement lacks a passing required test in current JUnit evidence.
Evidence is missing, stale, skipped, or bound to a different code snapshot.
